context: Tests whether the agent follows branch naming conventions including type prefix, issue number inclusion, kebab-case formatting, and correct creation from main. Also tests that git mv is used for the file rename to preserve history rather than a manual copy-and-delete approach.

checklist.name: Branch type: fix
checklist.description: branch-setup.sh or branch-decision.md uses the 'fix/' prefix for the branch (since the task is a bug fix)

checklist.name: Issue number in branch name
checklist.description: The branch name includes '312' — e.g. fix/312-session-timeout or fix/312-network-session-timeout

checklist.name: Kebab-case branch name
checklist.description: The description segment of the branch name uses hyphens, not underscores or camelCase (e.g. session-timeout not session_timeout or sessionTimeout)

checklist.name: Lowercase branch name
checklist.description: The entire branch name is lowercase with no uppercase letters

checklist.name: Branch description length
checklist.description: The description portion of the branch name (after the slash) is between 2 and 5 words/segments when split by hyphens (excluding the issue number)

checklist.name: Branch created from main
checklist.description: branch-setup.sh checks out or switches to main before creating the new branch, OR explicitly notes the branch is based on main

checklist.name: Uses git mv for rename
checklist.description: branch-setup.sh uses 'git mv session.js session-manager.js' (or equivalent git mv command) rather than cp+rm, mv+git add, or any non-git rename

checklist.name: No cp/mv without git mv
checklist.description: branch-setup.sh does NOT use plain 'mv session.js' or 'cp session.js' followed by 'git add' as the rename strategy

checklist.name: History preservation noted
checklist.description: branch-decision.md mentions that git mv preserves history or that this is the reason for using git mv

checklist.name: Branch name documented
checklist.description: branch-decision.md explicitly states the chosen branch name
